title: Introduce callsite-weighted cost matrix and sampled log anchors for long-tail attribution
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Added a callsite-aware cost attribution matrix and sampled log anchoring to help SREs and platform engineers identify costly callsites and tie them back to representative logs. New dashboard panels and an adaptive alert combiner included.
body:
Summary: This PR adds a callsite-weighted cost matrix (CWCM) that attributes per-invocation token cost and latency to callsites (route + callsite fingerprint) rather than only to high-level routes. In parallel, it introduces a sampled log anchors feature that captures representative log/context samples for high-cost callsites to speed triage of long-tail cost/latency regressions. Motivation: SLO noise from latent long-tail invocations has been difficult to debug because route-level rollups hide callsite-level variance. CWCM provides a dense, time-windowed matrix for cost attribution and the log anchors provide the human-readable context to act on anomalies.

What this changes (high level):
- Metrics: new time-series and histogram metrics emitted at callsite granularity: cwcm.cost.sum, cwcm.cost.p50/p95/p99, cwcm.latency.* and cwcm.invocations.count. All metrics include labels: tenant_id, route, model_variant, callsite_fingerprint, sequence_length_bucket.
- Tracing: span enrichment adds callsite_fingerprint and cost_bucket tags. Added a span-mapping helper to resolve callsite -> route mapping at ingestion time to avoid downstream joins.
- Logging: sampled_log_anchor service that stores compressed context snippets (truncated prompt, truncated response, key metadata) for the top-N callsites by rolling cost. Anchors are sampled deterministically by hash to keep storage bounded.
- Dashboard: new dashboard 'Callsite Cost Matrix' with a heatmap view, per-callsite sparklines, and a drilldown panel that links to sampled log anchors and trace timeline.
- Alerts: 'callsite-long-tail' composite alert that combines CWCM p99 delta with anchor-volume dropouts to reduce false positives. Adaptive cooldown reduces noisy flapping by suppressing alerts for low-volume callsites unless absolute cost exceeds a threshold.

Description (single-string details): The implementation is split across three commits and touches the metrics emission layer, trace enrichment, a small storage backend for anchors, and Grafana dashboard JSON. Commit 1 adds metric emitters and the CWCM aggregator with a bounded in-memory sliding window implementation (configurable via env vars). Commit 2 adds span enrichment, a lightweight mapping cache, and instrumentation tests. Commit 3 implements the sampled_log_anchor producer, an API to fetch anchors for the dashboard, and the dashboard JSON + alert rules. The sampled anchor store is implemented as a sharded RocksDB-backed local cache with TTL + periodic compaction; entry size is capped to avoid OOM. The anchor API supports pagination and optional context expansion for on-demand log fetches.

Commits (summary):
- 1a2f9b3 Add CWCM metric emitters and sliding window aggregator
- 3b0e441 Enrich spans with callsite_fingerprint and cost tags; add mapping cache
- 7d5f2c0 Implement sampled_log_anchor store, anchor API, dashboard JSON and alerts

Files touched (high-level):
- gateway/metrics/cwcm.py (new) - metric producer and aggregator
- runtime/span_enricher.go - adds callsite_fingerprint & cost tags to spans
- observability/anchors/store.go - sampled log anchor store + compaction
- observability/anchors/api.go - anchor fetch API used by dashboard
- grafana/dashboards/callsite-cost-matrix.json - dashboard panels and variables
- infra/helm/values.observability.yaml - feature flags and resource defaults
- docs/observability/callsite-cost-matrix.md - design doc and runbook
- tests/integration/test_cwcm_end2end.py - e2e tests for aggregation & anchors
- Makefile update to package dashboard JSON in release

Testing & CI: Unit tests for the aggregator and span enrichment were added. Integration test spins up a small synthetic workload generator to validate top-N anchors and that the aggregator decays costs over the sliding window. CI: all checks passing on the final run (lint, unit, integration, e2e smoke). Observability metrics validated in staging with synthetic guardrails to ensure cardinality stays within configured limits.

Review thread (selected):
- Ravi Singh (reviewer): "Can we ensure callsite_fingerprint cardinality can't explode? Suggest a soft limit & an eviction policy visible in metrics. Also recommend a sampling knob per-tenant."
  - Maya Chen (author): "Added a soft_cardinality_limit setting with a per-tenant override and emitted cwcm.cardinality.current + cwcm.cardinality.evicted metrics. See metrics/cwcm.py lines 210-268."
- Anna Lopez (reviewer): "We should avoid coupling anchor storage to local disk for Dedicated and Private installs. Can we provide a pluggable backend interface?"
  - Maya Chen: "Implemented a backend interface and left RocksDB as the default. Added docs on configuring S3/Redis backends; included an example for private installer."
- Diego Morales (reviewer): "Alert suppression looks promising, but can we test it under bursty traffic?"
  - Maya Chen: "Added an integration scenario that replays burst traces and validates that the composite alert fires only for the expected callsites when absolute cost threshold is crossed."

Follow-ups tracked: ENG-2145 (expose per-tenant sampling), SRE-98 (tune default thresholds), ENG-2210 (rollout plan / gradual weighting). Created a short runbook at docs/observability/callsite-cost-matrix.md with triage steps and example queries.

Backward compatibility & performance: Metrics are additive (new metrics only) and default sampling is conservative. The sliding window aggregator uses a constant memory bound; measured heap increase in staging was ~12MB per 1000 active callsites under our test workload. Tracing overhead is +0.6% p50 end-to-end in microbenchmarks.

Security & privacy: Anchors redact PII via the existing redact pipeline (prompt/response scrubbers) before persisting. Access to anchors is gated by the observability API ACLs. For Private installs, default retention for anchors is 7 days.

Rollout plan: Feature gated behind OBS_CWCM_ENABLED; rollout as follows: enable in staging -> Canary (5% of traffic, dedicated region) -> Gradual ramp to 25% with alerts monitored -> Full roll. Config knobs allow disabling anchors and lowering cardinality limits per-tenant.

Merge: Squash-and-merge after sign-offs. Post-merge: tag release observability/v1.17.0 and run infra job to publish dashboard JSON to central grafana provisioning.

Notes: The CWCM provides a middle ground between per-invocation expensive attribution and coarse route rollups; the anchors are tuned to make the output actionable for SREs without adding storage pressure. This design is meant to complement, not replace, existing token-level heatmaps and span digests.
